tasks.title: AtWreck picks nearest shelter by Teams, not by shadow, and returns
tasks.why: DirectFire.Wrecks.cs:126-134 picks `best` as the nearest shelter whose Teams bit (built over the whole reach disc at lines 99-103) has an enemy, then at line 144 returns outright if InShadow(...) == 0. An enemy on the flank of a nearer wreck wins the pick and silences the shooter for the tick; he never tries a farther wreck whose shadow does have enemies in it. Covering machine guns go quiet in exactly the case decisions.md row 221 ([N5.3]) was fought over. P1.
tasks.done_when: a new case in Assets/_Project/Tests/Sim/WreckDecayTests.cs with a nearer wreck that has no enemy in its shadow and a farther wreck that does: red before the fix (no shot fired), green after (the farther wreck is fired at)

tasks.title: Shelter Body uses full WreckBlastReach, Reach's half of it does not match
tasks.why: DirectFire.Wrecks.cs:88 builds `reach` as ShelterRadius + WreckBlastReach * 0.5 * scale ("halved", per the comment at line 47), but line 103 sets Body to the full WreckBlastReach * scale, twice that half-width. A man up to 2 m off the firing line (at scale 1) is still counted as in the shadow and kept down by InShadow's `side > s.Body` test at line 176, [N5.3] applied at only half the intended width. P3, decide which figure is meant and make code and comment agree.
tasks.done_when: a new case in Assets/_Project/Tests/Sim/WreckDecayTests.cs with an enemy placed at the current Body width but outside the intended half-width: red before, green after the fix makes Body and Reach consistent

tasks.title: BuildShelters excludes vehicles from Teams, InShadow suppresses them anyway
tasks.why: DirectFire.Wrecks.cs:99 skips Vehicle and Airborne flags when building a shelter's Teams bitmask, so a wreck sheltering only vehicles is never picked as a target. But InShadow at lines 168-170 counts and suppresses any alive enemy including vehicles once a wreck is otherwise picked for infantry. The set that makes a wreck worth firing at is not the set InShadow keeps down. P3.
tasks.done_when: a new case in Assets/_Project/Tests/Sim/WreckDecayTests.cs showing a vehicle in a wreck's shadow is (or is deliberately not) suppressed consistent with whether it counted toward Teams

tasks.title: InShadow sweeps the spatial hash twice per wreck shot
tasks.why: DirectFire.Wrecks.cs calls InShadow once to count at line 144 (near = 0) and again to suppress at line 155, each re-walking the same spatial-hash cells around the shelter. One pass that counts and defers the AddSuppression call would halve this per-shot cost. P3, perf only, no hashed value moves.
tasks.done_when: existing WreckDecayTests.cs cases stay green; a new case asserts InShadow's suppression total is unchanged after collapsing to one pass
